title: Part History columns stay fixed for a long wrapped entry at each width
custom_preconds: Admin. Part with a long "Description updated … | Changed at: …" entry.
custom_steps:
1. Open Part History at 1600 px
  2. Resize to 1280 and 1024 px
  3. Resize to 375 px
custom_expected:
1. Staff ~240, Date ~190, Time ~150 px; Event wraps; other columns don't move
  2. Narrower fixed columns; no sideways scroll
  3. Automatic layout; Event visible
